name: RealMode
evidence: clrlwi r3,r3,2; mtsrr0; MSR without IR/DR; rfi: the SDK's RealMode, first rfi reached at boot (session 2)

name: KPADRead
evidence: KPAD object order against Victorious's ELF; called by the game's input module (800167E8) as KPADRead(chan, buf, 16); walks samples of 0x84 bytes

name: KPADInit
evidence: KPAD object order; called once by the game's input setup (80016558)

name: KPADReset
evidence: KPAD object order (148 bytes, Victorious 160); called by the game's input setup

name: KPADSetPosParam
evidence: KPAD object order: first of four 28-byte parameter setters, as in Victorious

name: KPADSetAccParam
evidence: KPAD object order: second of the four setters, as in Victorious

name: OSLoadContext
evidence: signature in Victorious's symbolised ELF, not in Dolphin's database; loads r1 and the GPRs from the context (lmw), sets MSR and SRR0/1, rfi: the one function a thread switch returns through

name: WPADSetSpeakerVolume
evidence: signature in Victorious's ELF only; clamps its argument to 0..0x7F and stores it in one global byte between OSDisableInterrupts and OSRestoreInterrupts

name: WPADSendStreamData
evidence: signature in Victorious's ELF only (0x210 bytes); hooked, it carries the Remote speaker's sounds the game plays (the shield's parries, heard in session 3)
